name: Green Card Tracker
summary: Reads the US Visa Bulletin the day it comes out and tells you exactly where your priority date stands, so you never have to decode the charts again.
handles: Checks travel.state.gov on its own schedule and spots the new month's bulletin
Reads your row and column on both charts: Final Action and Dates for Filing
Tells you how far the line moved and how many months you are from current
Says plainly when you can file your I-485 or when your date is current
Keeps a month-by-month history and gives a clearly labelled rough ETA
Stays quiet when nothing changed, and tells you once if the page is down

fields.label: Visa category
fields.help: EB1, EB2, EB3, EW (Other Workers), EB4, EB5, F1, F2A, F2B, F3 or F4.

fields.label: Country of chargeability
fields.help: India, China, Mexico, Philippines, or All (every other country).

fields.label: Your priority date
fields.help: From your I-797 receipt, as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2014-03-15. Leave empty to just follow the dates.

after: Say "status" to see this month's dates for your category now. If you skipped the priority date, tell it "my date 2014-03-15".
